angle: The Indian deal shape is the schema itself: towers, floors and units, Token to Registered with a milestone plan, and RERA carrying channel partners, none of it bolted on as custom fields.

hook.question: Why model a tower by hand?

scenes.vo: Projects hold towers, towers hold floors, and floors hold real units.

chip.title: Towers, floors, units
chip.sub: The unit is the object, not a deal

scenes.vo: Token, then Agreement, then Registered, with construction milestones created at booking time.
Each partner carries a RERA id, an approval status, and a commission percent.
Site visits are their own record, with a schedule and written feedback.
Reports read in lakh and crore, because that is how the market talks.

chip.title: Lakh and crore, native
chip.sub: Values shown the way deals are quoted

cta.tag: Built for how India sells homes.
cta.note: EstateCRM. The schema fits the market.
